headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 26, 2026**
article:
The Chicago Cubs had a dominant day, taking down the New York Mets in two games. Dansby Swanson led the charge with a grand slam and 2 home runs in the first game, while A.J. Ewing contributed 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs in the second game. The Cubs also acquired LHP David Peterson from the New York Mets in a trade.

Several players were placed on the injured list, including Ryne Nelson (Arizona Diamondbacks), Johan Rojas (Philadelphia Phillies), Cody Freeman (Texas Rangers), Marcus Semien (New York Mets), Zack Gelof (Athletics), Spencer Horwitz (Pittsburgh Pirates), Steven Matz (Tampa Bay Rays), and Ryan McMahon (New York Yankees).

The St. Louis Cardinals traded RHP Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays for a player to be named later, while the Washington Nationals traded SS Marcus Brown to the Houston Astros for cash. The Atlanta Braves acquired RHP Tyler Schoff from the Washington Nationals, and the Chicago Cubs acquired RHP Jayden Murray from the Houston Astros.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Rangers in Miami**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 2-4 victory over the Texas Rangers, with John King earning the win. Otto Lopez led the Marlins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 2-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Cubs Cruise Past Mets 10-3**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the New York Mets, securing a 10-3 victory behind a strong performance from their offense. Dansby Swanson led the charge, hitting a grand slam and collecting 2 home runs, 7 RBIs, and 2 hits in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Mets 10-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 10-5 victory over the New York Mets, with A.J. Ewing leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Huascar Brazobán made a strong pitching appearance, striking out 4 batters in 2 innings without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge White Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 4-3 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Shawn Armstrong earning the win. Braden Montgomery led the Guardians' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Suffer Blowout Loss to Rays**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals fell to the Tampa Bay Rays 13-2 in a one-sided matchup. Impact hitters for the Rays included Carter Jensen, Jonathan Aranda, Junior Caminero, Richie Palacios, Cedric Mullins, and Victor Mesa Jr.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Mariners 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 5-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, handing their opponents their latest loss. Impact performances came from Pirates' catcher Henry Davis and pitcher Bryce Miller, while Mariners' second baseman Brandon Lowe also made a notable contribution.

top_news.title: **Ryne Nelson Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks right-handed pitcher Ryne Nelson has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a strained right elbow.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade, while sending third baseman Cole Mathis to the New York Mets.
